onboarding.livingkingdoms.title: A new beginning
onboarding.livingkingdoms.text.welcome: Welcome to %s, traveler. These homes are more than shelter: they are a community. Before we ask for your help, let me tell you about the people who live here.
onboarding.livingkingdoms.text.people: Our farmers keep the stores supplied, builders turn materials into homes, and guards protect the roads. Talk to our neighbors: their needs will guide our first steps together.
onboarding.livingkingdoms.text.needs: We need food, tools and room for new families. Pillagers and the undead threaten travelers beyond our walls. The Quest Board holds real requests; helping it grow also means protecting this region.
onboarding.livingkingdoms.text.responsib: Are you sure you want to help? You will choose construction projects, provide supplies, organize workers and prepare our defenses. Requests and rewards are handled here, in person. We grow one step at a time.
onboarding.livingkingdoms.text.naming: Then let us begin. Choose a name for the kingdom we will build together. The village, its people and its land will remain the same. Use 1–32 letters, digits, spaces, apostrophes or hyphens.
onboarding.livingkingdoms.text.joining: %s already has a name and a community of helpers. Join us to share the work; the kingdom belongs to all its people. Its name and territory will stay as they are.
onboarding.livingkingdoms.help: I want to help this kingdom
onboarding.livingkingdoms.accept: Yes, you can count on me

bond.livingkingdoms.greeting.loyal: %s: «For you, anything. I brought you something.»

bond.livingkingdoms.content: %s has everything they need today. Come back tomorrow.

ui.livingkingdoms.expedition.help: Send this resident away to bring back resources, loot or even a survivor.
ui.livingkingdoms.expedition.requirement: Only residents without a job can travel; up to 3 away per kingdom.
ui.livingkingdoms.expedition.explain: Time counts while the world runs. You receive the loot with a banner on their return, or on your next login.
expedition.livingkingdoms.describe.forag: Logs, wheat, fruit and sometimes honeycomb.
expedition.livingkingdoms.describe.mine: Stone, iron, coal, sometimes gold or a diamond.
expedition.livingkingdoms.describe.explo: Emeralds, maps, tomes — and a 25% chance to rescue a survivor who asks to join.

expedition.livingkingdoms.rescued: %s found a survivor! Check Immigration to welcome them.
expedition.livingkingdoms.while_away: Expeditions returned while you were away
alarm.livingkingdoms.sounded: 🔔 The alarm rings in %s! Villagers run for shelter and every monster nearby glows.

event.livingkingdoms.started.caravan: 🐪 A merchant caravan arrives in %s with rare goods!
event.livingkingdoms.started.treasure: 🗺 A treasure is hidden somewhere in %s. Follow the HUD compass!
management.livingkingdoms.fortify_help: Raise a ring of walls just inside the border, paid from Kingdom Storage. Paths get doors; posts every 12 blocks hold archers (guards with a bow or crossbow).
management.livingkingdoms.fortify_breach: %s breaches: repaired from storage once safe.
technique.livingkingdoms.master_smith.ef: Royal Whetstone refinements cost one less.
ui.livingkingdoms.contracts.techniques_n: Reach Loyal friendship with a worker to learn their craft.

wall.livingkingdoms.max: Your walls are already a fortress.
wall.livingkingdoms.threatened: Not while the kingdom is under attack.
wall.livingkingdoms.no_stock: Kingdom Storage lacks the materials for the walls.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.farmer.0: The wheat grows faster when I hum to it. Don't tell the others.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.farmer.1: A chicken stared at me for an hour today. I think it knows something.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.farmer.2: Bring me bone meal and I'll name a pumpkin after you, %1$s.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.farmer.3: Rain, sun, rain. Perfect. Now if only the crows paid rent.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.farmer.4: I dreamt of a carrot the size of the Town Hall. Best night ever.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.guard.0: I've counted every fence post in %2$s. Twice. All present.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.guard.1: A zombie tried to sneak in wearing a pumpkin. Nice try.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.guard.3: If you see a creeper, scream. Politely, but scream.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.guard.4: A bow on the watchtower and I'd feel ten feet tall.
Measure twice, cut once, then blame the creeper.
I can hear the stone bricks wanting to be stacked.
Give me a pickaxe and a reason, %1$s.
Every roof in %2$s has my fingerprints on it. Literally, I fell off one.
One day I'll build a tower so tall the moon complains.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.lumberja: Trees are just very slow, very polite enemies.
I replant every one. Mostly out of guilt.
Birch smells like Tuesdays. Don't ask.
My axe has a name. It's Gerald.
Leaves in my hair, sap on my boots. A good day.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.miner.0: Down there it's quiet. Except for the hissing. Always the hissing.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.miner.1: I found a diamond once. Then lava found my diamond.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.miner.2: Sunlight? Overrated. Torches are where it's at.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.miner.3: The deeper you dig, the stranger the echoes get.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.miner.4: Iron for the kingdom, coal for the soul.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.blacksmi: Hot iron tells you its mood. Today it's grumpy.
Bring me a Royal Whetstone and watch that blade sing.
I burned my eyebrows off again. They grow back. Mostly.
Every sword I make is my favorite. Don't tell the axes.
Clang. Clang. Clang. Sorry, I talk like this now.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.merchant: Everything has a price. Especially friendship. Kidding! Mostly.
Emeralds are just green feelings you can trade.
A wandering trader tried to sell me my own llama.
Buy low, sell high, nap in between.
For you, %1$s, a very special price. Same as everyone's.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.idle.0: I'd love a job. Or a hobby. Or a hat.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.idle.1: Got any work for me, %1$s? I'm very good at standing.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.idle.2: Send me somewhere far. I'll bring back something shiny.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.idle.3: I've been practicing my pointing. Watch: there.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.idle.4: Everyone in %2$s has a job but me. I'm in charge of vibes.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.odd.0: Do you ever think the sun is just a very bright square?
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.odd.1: I tried talking to the cows. They talk back, but only about grass.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.odd.2: Last night the moon winked at me. I winked back. We're even.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.odd.3: If I stack enough dirt, can I touch the clouds? Asking for me.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.odd.4: My nose is my best feature. Thank you for noticing.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.odd.5: Endermen are just shy. Very, very shy and very, very tall.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.odd.6: I sneezed and a bee forgave me. Good day.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.odd.7: Hmm. Hrmm. Hrrrm. Sorry, family habit.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.odd.8: They say a hero lives in %2$s. Is it you? It's you, isn't it.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.odd.9: I counted the stars. Lost count. Started over. Fell asleep.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.odd.10: A slime followed me home. I named it Jelly. Jelly is gone now.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.odd.11: Why do chests go 'creak'? What are they hiding?
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.danger.0: Did you hear that? Something's coming. Close the doors!
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.danger.1: I'm not scared. My knees are just dancing.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.danger.2: Protect us, %1$s, and I'll bake you something nice.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.festival: Music! Food! Fireworks! Best week in %2$s!
I danced so hard I lost a shoe. Worth it.
Contracts pay double today. Go, go, go!
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.rain.0: Rain again. My hat is now a bucket.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.rain.1: The crops love this. I don't.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.rain.2: Smell that? Wet dirt. Best smell in the world.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.night.0: Shouldn't you be in bed? Monsters love late walkers.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.night.1: At night the village creaks like it's dreaming.
resident.livingkingdoms.chatter.night.2: I keep a torch by my bed. And another torch for that torch.

stage.livingkingdoms.reached.town: Now a Town: smoking chimneys and cobbled skirts
stage.livingkingdoms.reached.city: Now a City: banners and flowering hedges at every home
decor.livingkingdoms.tier.village_homes: Village homes: lanterns and flower beds
decor.livingkingdoms.tier.town_homes: Town homes: chimneys and cobbled skirts

resident.livingkingdoms.thanks: Oh! Just what I wanted. Thank you, %1$s!
resident.livingkingdoms.no_item: Hmm, you don't seem to have it with you.
resident.livingkingdoms.level_effect.gua: Each level: more health, faster and harder hits, iron armour at level 3. Earns XP fighting.

ledger.livingkingdoms.unavailable: This ledger isn't part of a building of a kingdom you help.
management.livingkingdoms.benefit.tavern: Travellers stop by more often (×2 chance, more per level) and you can hire one on the spot for a few emeralds.
management.livingkingdoms.hire_help: Hire a traveller for %s emeralds. They move into a free bed right away.
management.livingkingdoms.deposit_all_he: Put every log, stone, iron ingot and wheat you carry into Kingdom Storage. Items left in the warehouse's barrels and chests are also stored every 30 seconds.
management.livingkingdoms.archer_help: Archers get a bow and man watchtower tops and wall posts; patrols walk the kingdom with a sword. The guard must be nearby (loaded).
management.livingkingdoms.upgrade_missin: Kingdom Storage lacks the materials for this upgrade: check the costs below (needed / have). Deposit at a Kingdom Storage or the Warehouse ledger.
management.livingkingdoms.upgrade_visual: Each upgrade also improves the building itself: level 2 stone bricks and spruce, level 3 deepslate, dark oak and banners.
tavern.livingkingdoms.no_emeralds: You need %s emeralds to hire a traveller.
tavern.livingkingdoms.no_bed: There is no free bed: build or upgrade a house first.
tavern.livingkingdoms.hired: %1$s accepted your offer (%2$s emeralds) and moves into the kingdom!
management.livingkingdoms.walls_help: Gates are 3-wide openings spaced evenly from the south; path crossings keep their doors. Towers and gatehouse tops are archer posts. New wall tiers re-dress towers and gatehouses.
management.livingkingdoms.walls_none: No walls yet. Raise a palisade first (costs below on the first button).
management.livingkingdoms.wall_gates_hel: Cycle 1→2→3→4 main gates; the ring is rebuilt right away (free).
management.livingkingdoms.wall_towers_he: Four 3×3 towers on the diagonals of the ring, six blocks tall; archers man their tops.
management.livingkingdoms.wall_gatehouse: Every main gate gets flanking towers, a double lintel and kingdom banners. Needs stone walls.
wall.livingkingdoms.gates_set: The walls now have %s main gates.
wall.livingkingdoms.towers_built: 🏰 %s wall towers rise on the diagonals!
ui.livingkingdoms.defense.summon_help: Bring the linked patrol to the edge of the kingdom so you can fight it. If nobody from the patrol is around anymore, the alert ends.

chapter.livingkingdoms.fortress.title: A True Fortress
chapter.livingkingdoms.fortress.story: Finish the reinforced walls and the kingdom will be spoken of far away.

lodge.livingkingdoms.name: Founders' Lodge
lodge.livingkingdoms.benefit: The old camp, now a roofed hall: it keeps the kingdom stone and the Quest Board and works as a small inn (travellers stop by, hire one here).
lodge.livingkingdoms.built: 🏠 With the Town Hall standing, the founders' camp of %s becomes the Founders' Lodge!
